events_detected.title: US Treasury coordinated yen intervention with Japan — first since 1998
events_detected.description: US Treasury and Japan's Finance Ministry conducted a rare coordinated yen-buying intervention on July 31/Aug 1. First joint US-Japan FX intervention since 1998. Treasury Secretary Bessent's notepad read 'To Do Buy Japanese Yen $5-10 bil'. Both sides signal readiness for further action.

events_detected.title: Iran war: Hormuz ceasefire talks near deal but naval blockade active
events_detected.description: US-Iran war ongoing. MOU/ceasefire suspended, US naval blockade reimposed — 44 vessels redirected, 2 disabled, 2 boarded. Iran and Oman finalizing Strait of Hormuz agreement. Trump says deal could come this week. Iran simultaneously boosting military strength during talks. Iran threatens to target US warships in Hormuz.

events_detected.title: Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in DRC — largest ever, WHO PHEIC, intensifying
events_detected.description: WHO declared PHEIC on May 16, 2026. As of July 30: 3,605 confirmed cases, 1,587 deaths (44% CFR). Outbreak expanded to 5 provinces, 49 health zones. Largest Ebola outbreak ever recorded in DRC. No vaccine for Bundibugyo strain. WHO warns 'intensifying at exceptional pace'.

events_detected.title: Korean Won surges 8.8% — fastest since 1997 Asian Financial Crisis
events_detected.description: Korean Won gained 8.8% against USD in July 2026 — steepest monthly gain since the 1997 Asian Financial Crisis. Driven by US-Japan coordinated yen intervention spillover. KOSPI crashed from peak, Samsung/SK Hynix wobbled. Constitutional crisis and attempted coup backdrop in South Korea.

events_detected.title: Argentina-China $19bn currency swap renewed for 5 years — deadline Aug 6
events_detected.description: Argentina's $19bn China currency swap was set to expire Aug 6, 2026. RENEWED on Aug 5 for 5 years (previously 3-year terms). Removes default/renewal risk through 2027 presidential election. US had pressured Argentina to wind down the swap. Bloomberg confirmed renewal.

PBOC pledged 'appropriately loose monetary policy' for H2 2026. Counter-cyclical support. No emergency action.
